name: Furudono (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Furudono town emblem in white: a broken ring divided by a vertical stroke, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Furudono, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 December 1957.

features.role: Furudono town emblem — a broken ring divided by a vertical stroke, like a stylised character
